directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. The 24 mm cell here is 100 m horizontal / 300 m vertical. That is not the low-pressure 60 table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric 60 at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki double pump 112, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Electric Low Pressure 60, which prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, hopper 0.5 m³, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The model cell also prints Electric 75-60. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
directAnswer.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。这里的 24 mm 格是水平 100 m / 垂直 300 m。不是低压 60 那张表。邢台河北品锦机械把电动60列为90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、细石 200 m / 600 m、13 mm 石子 150 m / 450 m、24 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m、料斗 0.7 m³、川崎双泵 112、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、3300 kg。不要把同一工况挪到电动低压60，那一行印的是75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m、24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、料斗 0.5 m³、川崎双泵 100、外形 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。型号格同时印 Electric 75-60。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

heading.en: What the pour has to match

body.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. The 24 mm cell here is 100 m horizontal / 300 m vertical. That is not the low-pressure 60 table. The published Electric 60 row is 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki double pump 112, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg.

heading.en: Do not slide onto the neighbouring row

body.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, hopper 0.5 m³, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The model cell also prints Electric 75-60. The shared job site in the photograph does not merge the two tables. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
body.zh: 电动低压60印的是75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m、24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、料斗 0.5 m³、川崎双泵 100、外形 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。型号格同时印 Electric 75-60。照片里的同类现场不能把两张表并成一张。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

question.en: Is the photograph a Pinjin jobsite?
question.zh: 这张照片是品锦的工地吗？

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.
answer.zh: 不是。它表示的是这类工况。河北品锦机械没有把它写成合同记录。

question.en: What does the Electric 60 row print for this check?
question.zh: 电动60这一行，这次要核对的数字是什么？

answer.en: The 24 mm cell here is 100 m horizontal / 300 m vertical. That is not the low-pressure 60 table.
answer.zh: 这里的 24 mm 格是水平 100 m / 垂直 300 m。不是低压 60 那张表。

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。电动60只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
